description: Dart source file for the NoteEditorScreen widget in a Flutter app, enabling note creation and editing with summary generation.

classes.name: NoteEditorScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides UI for creating or editing a note, including features for entering title, content, generating summary, and saving.

classes.name: _NoteEditorScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and logic for NoteEditorScreen, including form handling, summary generation, and save/discard behavior.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, populating fields if editing an existing note and setting up listeners.

methods.name: _onContentChanged
methods.description: Updates the _hasChanges flag when content or title changes.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _summarize
methods.description: Handles generating a summary for the note by calling the NotesService.summarizeNote method.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves the note, either updating existing or creating a new one, via the NotesService.

methods.name: _onWillPop
methods.description: Intercepts back navigation to prompt user about unsaved changes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including form fields, buttons, and summary display.
